Posts are plain Markdown. Inline maths sits in a sentence, like $p(\theta \mid y) \propto p(y \mid \theta)\,p(\theta)$,
and display maths gets its own line:

$$
\mathrm{surprisal}(x) = -\log_2 P(x \mid \text{context})
$$

A footnote is easy to add.[^1] Code is highlighted, and readers get a copy button:

```python
import math

def surprisal(p: float) -> float:
    """Information content, in bits, of an event with probability p."""
    return -math.log2(p)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## A callout
Useful for a caveat, a definition, or a warning.
:::
